items.title: Execution branch and migration applied
items.precondition: Before or at start of execution
steps: Confirm branch kylie/message-status-icon descends from origin/dev
Run knex migrate:latest and confirm messages.delivered_at exists
items.expected: Branch has messenger + websockets; migration applied cleanly.
items.evidence: 2026-07-31: branch from origin/dev 312e03a; npm run migrate batch 4 applied 20260731140000_message_delivered_at.

items.title: Sent icon on own outgoing message
items.precondition: Two mutuals; A signed in; open thread with B
steps: Look at the bottom-right meta area of A's bubble
items.expected: Open blue circle with check mark (Sent) appears immediately after send succeeds.
items.evidence: Author session: sent state visible before delivery upgrade.

items.title: Delivered icon when peer receives message
items.precondition: B signed in with socket connected (same thread open or inbox)
steps: A sends a message while B is online
items.expected: Icon upgrades to filled blue circle with check mark (Delivered) within ~1s of B receiving message:new.
items.evidence: Author screenshot 2026-07-31: filled blue circle + check on outgoing bubble.

items.title: Seen icon when peer reads thread
items.precondition: A sent message already Delivered; B opens the thread (mark read)
steps: B opens or focuses the conversation with A
Observe A's status icon on that message
items.expected: Icon becomes a tiny circular profile photo of B (Seen).
items.waiver: Two-browser Seen verify deferred; conversation:peer-read emit path implemented and typed.

items.title: Delivered via REST when peer is offline
items.precondition: B disconnected or not on messages; A sends message
steps: A refreshes or waits for poll/socket reconnect
items.expected: A eventually sees Delivered after B loads the thread (fetch marks delivered_at).
items.waiver: markInboundUndeliveredAsDelivered on listMessages coded; offline scenario not re-run at finalize.

items.title: No status on incoming or unsent bubbles
items.precondition: Thread with sent and unsent messages
steps: A unsends a message and inspect A's tombstone row
items.expected: No status icons on incoming messages or unsent placeholders.

items.title: Live Seen update without reload
items.precondition: Both sockets connected; A viewing thread where B has unread from A
steps: A watches status on latest outgoing message without refreshing
items.expected: Seen avatar appears via conversation:peer-read event without page reload.
items.waiver: Socket handler + MessagesPage listener implemented; interactive two-browser pass deferred.

items.title: Build and typecheck
items.expected: Green build; no new type errors from status fields or components.
items.evidence: 2026-07-31 finalize: npm run build green (api tsc + frontend vite).
